brief.en: Freezes zombies that step on it, and extinguishes flames
brief.zh: 冻结接触到的僵尸，并熄灭火炬

description.en: Iceberg Lettuces freezes a zombie when stepped on.
description.zh: 冰冻生菜会冻结一只踩中他的僵尸。

chat.en: Don't get lost staring into Iceberg's adorably cute eyes. If you do, it will be your last step... but only if you're a zombie.
chat.zh: 不要因为盯着他过分可爱的双眼而迷失自我。不然的话你将没法迈出下一步……除非你不是一只僵尸。

text.zh: 接触时爆裂，使一只僵尸冻结一段时间
